title: Exploring vivid red light emanating europium complexes incorporating a β-ketoester antenna for advanced displays: a detailed photophysical, Judd–Ofelt and computational investigation
content:

The Eu(III) samples based on the β-ketoester-functionalized ligand and secondary sensitizers revealed high luminous intensity, a band gap in semiconductor range and excellent color purity, highlighting the efficient transmission of energy.
